notes.title: Tether Brawl Livestream (With the Devs)
notes.content:
Hey Brawlers!

We will be livestreaming the demo version of Tether Brawl right before Next Fest ends! 

[list]
[*] Fast-Paced Local Co-Op: Grab a friend or AI partner and get ready for non-stop excitement.
[*] Core Hooks: See how being literally tethered together shapes every move, creating hilarious team-ups—or unexpected sabotages.
[*] Release Date: We’re launching late March 2025, so consider this your inside look before the big day.
[/list]

Definitely chat and interact while you watch! Be sure to wishlist it if you are interested. See you on the steam. 

— The Tether Brawl Team

notes.title: We’re In Steam Next Fest — Get Ready for Tethered Chaos!
notes.content:
Hey Brawlers,
Tether Brawl is officially part of Steam Next Fest! Get ready for a whirlwind of cooperative (and competitive) madness where you and your partner are quite literally tethered together. Here’s what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Tether Mechanic: Work in sync—or gently sabotage each other!—as your characters remain linked by a single, unbreakable bond.
[*] Local Multiplayer Focus: Grab a friend for couch co-op fun, or show off your moves against AI if you’re playing solo.
[*] Fast-Paced Rounds: Each match is only 3 minutes, packing maximum excitement into every second.
[/list]

We’ll also be hosting a developer livestream during Next Fest (date TBA), so keep an eye out!  In the meantime, make sure to wishlist Tether Brawl to stay up to date!

—The Tether Brawl Team
